status: v4 adopted 2026-09-28 (Phase B fix 3): whole season with fading game weights (replaces last-4 window) and rest-of-season blend with actual season points per game. v3: minimal-playing-time rule, known-out players excluded from team volume, depth-chart QB1, betting-implied points (weekly). Fit 2019-2023, checked 2024, tested once on held-out 2025.
evaluation_policy: Compare fixed candidate and baseline on identical prior-selected players, retaining zero outcomes. Report early-season and full-window point MAE, workload error, and week-level differences. Do not tune on 2024 or 2025. Do not claim statistical significance or calibrated uncertainty from these fixed-weight experiments.
limitations: Prior strengths are transparent heuristics, not fitted optimal weights.

Snap share (PFR snap counts) informs WR/TE/RB targets and carries; routes run, red-zone locations, coaching, weather, and designed-run/scramble split are not modeled. No verified current injury feed in the core model.
Future workload is held at the current sample-aware role estimate; only schedule and fading defensive effects vary by future week.
Previous-season defensive information is discounted for continuity uncertainty; personnel continuity is not explicitly modeled.
Players with no current-season usage are not covered; players without prior-season history lack a player-specific volume prior.
Historical data may include subsequent stat corrections.

inputs: snap share x team volume x per-snap rate

evaluation.note: Weights fit on 2023 by non-negative least squares; 2024 not used in fitting. Same player cohort, zeros kept, chance-to-play applied. Consensus used only as a benchmark.

playing_time_fix.rule: Game excluded everywhere (volume, efficiency, last-season baseline, snap-share role) when snap share < 50% of the player's usual (median of previous 8) AND he missed the next game or was on the next injury report. Missed games are skipped, never zeros. Known-out players (IR/PUP/suspended/Out) do not use team volume. QBs: only the depth-chart QB1 or last week's starter gets volume; last week's starter loses it when the chart QB1 is back from injury with no designation, unless the fill-in has 3+ straight starts.
playing_time_fix.implied: Weekly only: scoring output x (1 + k x (team implied points - 22)), k per position fit on 2023, capped 0.8-1.25.

evaluation.note: Same players, players who played, v2 projection >= 5. Paired t-tests (player-weeks for error, weeks for pairs). Implied k fit on 2023 only. 2024 cases were inspected while shaping the QB depth rule, so 2025 (first use) is the clean test.

whole_season_fix.rule: Every game this season counts, weight 0.95^(games ago); last season continues the same fade (half weight after a team change); team totals the same; efficiency fades 0.9 per game over this season and last. Rest of season (weeks after the current one): points x (1-a) + actual season points per game x a, a = games/(games+10), injury-shortened games excluded; not for QBs who lost the starting job.

evaluation.note: ROS pair accuracy, top 30 QB/60 RB/72 WR/30 TE at Weeks 4/8/12, zeros kept. Weekly effect neutral out of sample.
